# 1 Chronicles Chapter 7 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 374v–375r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/1CH_007_page_001.jpg, 1CH_007_page_002.jpg

---

**7:1** And-the-sons of-Yissakhar: Tola, and-Pu'ah, Yashuv, and-Shimron — four. **7:2** And-the-sons of-Tola: Uzzi, and-Refayah, and-Yeri'el, and-Yachmai, and-Yivsam, and-Shemu'el, heads of-the-house of-their-fathers of-Tola, mighty-ones of-valor [gibborei chayil] according-to-their-generations; their-number in-the-days of-David [was] twenty-two thousand six hundred. **7:3** And-the-sons of-Uzzi: Yizrachyah. And-the-sons of-Yizrachyah: Mikha'el, and-Ovadyah, and-Yo'el, Yishshiyyah — five, all of-them heads. **7:4** And-upon-them according-to-their-generations, according-to-the-house of-their-fathers, [were] troops of-the-host [gedudei tsava] of-war, thirty-six thousand, for they-multiplied [hirbu] wives and-sons. **7:5** And-their-brothers according-to-all the-families of-Yissakhar, mighty-ones of-valor, eighty-seven thousand — the-total-enrollment [hityachsam] of-all.

**7:6** [The-sons of] Binyamin: Bela, and-Bekher, and-Yedi'a'el — three. **7:7** And-the-sons of-Bela: Etsbon, and-Uzzi, and-Uzzi'el, and-Yerimot, and-Iri — five, heads of-the-house of-fathers, mighty-ones of-valor, and-their-enrollment [was] twenty-two thousand and-thirty-four. **7:8** And-the-sons of-Bekher: Zemirah, and-Yo'ash, and-Eli'ezer, and-Elyo'enai, and-Omri, and-Yeremot, and-Aviyyah, and-Anatot, and-Alemet. All these [were] the-sons of-Bekher. **7:9** And-their-enrollment according-to-their-generations, heads of-the-house of-their-fathers, mighty-ones of-valor — twenty thousand two hundred.

**7:10** And-the-sons of-Yedi'a'el: Bilhan. And-the-sons of-Bilhan: Ye'ush, and-Binyamin, and-Ehud, and-Kena'anah, and-Zetan, and-Tarshish, and-Achishachar. **7:11** All these [were] the-sons of-Yedi'a'el, according-to-the-heads of-fathers, mighty-ones of-valor — seventeen thousand two hundred, going-out of-the-host [tsava] to-war.

**7:12** And-Shuppim and-Chuppim [were] the-sons of-Ir; Chushim [was] the-son of-Acher.

**7:13** The-sons of-Naftali: Yachtsi'el, and-Guni, and-Yetser, and-Shallum — the-sons of-Bilhah.

**7:14** The-sons of-Menasheh: Asri'el, whom his-Aramean [ha-Aramiyyah] concubine bore. She bore Makhir, the-father of-Gil'ad. **7:15** And-Makhir took a-wife for-Chuppim and-for-Shuppim, and-the-name of-his-sister [was] Ma'akhah. And-the-name of-the-second [was] Tselofchad, and-to-Tselofchad were daughters.

**7:16** And-bore Ma'akhah, the-wife of-Makhir, a-son, and-she-called his-name Peresh, and-the-name of-his-brother [was] Sheresh, and-his-sons [were] Ulam and-Reqem. **7:17** And-the-sons of-Ulam: Bedan. These [were] the-sons of-Gil'ad son of-Makhir son of-Menasheh.

**7:18** And-his-sister ha-Molekhet bore Ishhod, and-Avi'ezer, and-Machlah. **7:19** And-the-sons of-Shemida [were] Achyan, and-Shekhem, and-Liqchi, and-Ani'am.

**7:20** And-the-sons of-Efrayim: Shutelach, and-Bered his-son, and-Tachat his-son, and-El'adah his-son, and-Tachat his-son, **7:21** and-Zavad his-son, and-Shutelach his-son, and-Ezer, and-El'ad. And-killed-them the-men of-Gat, the-born-ones of-the-land [yilidei ha-arets], because they-came-down to-take their-livestock. **7:22** And-mourned [vayyit'abel] Efrayim their-father many days [yamim rabbim], and-came his-brothers to-comfort-him [lenachamo]. **7:23** And-he-went-in to his-wife, and-she-conceived and-bore a-son, and-he-called his-name Beri'ah, because in-evil [bera'ah] she-was [hayetah] in-his-house [beveto].

**7:24** And-his-daughter [was] She'erah, and-she-built Beit-Choron the-lower and-the-upper, and-Uzzen-She'erah.

**7:25** And-Refach his-son, and-Reshef, and-Telach his-son, and-Tachan his-son, **7:26** La'dan his-son, Ammihud his-son, Elishama his-son, **7:27** Nun his-son, Yehoshu'a his-son.

**7:28** And-their-possession and-their-dwelling [was] Beit-El and-its-daughters, and-to-the-east Na'aran, and-to-the-west Gezer and-its-daughters, and-Shekhem and-its-daughters, unto Ayyah and-its-daughters. **7:29** And-upon the-hands of-the-sons of-Menasheh: Beit-She'an and-its-daughters, Ta'nakh and-its-daughters, Megiddo and-its-daughters, Dor and-its-daughters. In-these dwelt the-sons of-Yosef son of-Yisra'el.

**7:30** The-sons of-Asher: Yimnah, and-Yishvah, and-Yishvi, and-Beri'ah, and-Serach their-sister. **7:31** And-the-sons of-Beri'ah: Chever, and-Malki'el — he [was] the-father of-Birzayit. **7:32** And-Chever fathered Yaflet, and-Shomer, and-Chotam, and-Shu'a their-sister. **7:33** And-the-sons of-Yaflet: Pasakh, and-Bimhal, and-Ashvat. These [were] the-sons of-Yaflet. **7:34** And-the-sons of-Shemer: Achi, and-Rohgah, Yechubbah, and-Aram. **7:35** And-the-sons of-Helem his-brother: Tsofach, and-Yimna, and-Shelesh, and-Amal. **7:36** The-sons of-Tsofach: Su'ach, and-Charnefer, and-Shu'al, and-Beri, and-Yimrah, **7:37** Betser, and-Hod, and-Shamma, and-Shilshah, and-Yitran, and-Be'era. **7:38** And-the-sons of-Yeter: Yefunneh, and-Pispa, and-Ara. **7:39** And-the-sons of-Ulla: Arach, and-Channi'el, and-Ritsya. **7:40** All these [were] the-sons of-Asher, heads of-the-house of-fathers, chosen [berurei], mighty-ones of-valor, heads of-the-princes [ha-nesi'im]. And-their-enrollment [hityachsam] in-the-host for-war [ba-tsava la-milchamah]: their-number [was] twenty-six thousand men.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.12 — "Acher":** Some scholars read *Acher* as a disguised form of "Dan," which is conspicuously absent from this tribal survey. If so, the Chronicler may have suppressed Dan's name due to its association with idolatry (Judges 18).

**v.21-23 — Death of Ephraim's sons:** A unique tradition not found elsewhere. The men of Gath killed Ezer and Elead during a cattle raid. Ephraim mourned, then fathered Beriah — named *bera'ah* ("in misfortune/evil"). This is one of the few personal narratives in the genealogies.

**v.24 — Sheerah:** One of the rarest notices in the Bible: a woman who built cities. *She'erah* is credited with founding both Beth-horons and Uzzen-sheerah. The Chronicler records this without comment.

**v.27 — "Joshua his son":** The genealogy of Ephraim leads to Joshua son of Nun — the conqueror of the land. The Chronicler places this genealogy strategically: Ephraim's greatest son receives no special treatment beyond a name in a list.

*— EMET*
